# Player cannot be moved in enemy and power-up gym scenes — Intake Brief

## Problem Statement

Since switchable player control types landed (AH-0MTF0EFNZ000RPVD), the player cannot be moved in the enemy gym scenes or the power-up gym scene when the saved control scheme is **asteroids**. The player loads the saved ship config (which now persists `controlScheme`), installs `AsteroidsModel` (which expects `{ forward, turnLeft, turnRight }` input), but the gym scenes still feed input through the legacy `keysToInput()` which always emits the 4-directional `{ up, down, left, right }` shape — the Asteroids model ignores it, so there is no thrust and no rotation.

## Users

- **Player / developer playtesting** — wants the same playable controls in every gym scene, honouring whatever scheme was saved in the ship-config gym.
- **AI agents / automated tests** — need scheme-aware input wiring that is unit-testable without booting a Phaser scene.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1 — Saved scheme honoured in all affected scenes:** With the **asteroids** scheme saved, the player moves in every enemy gym scene (E1 Scout, E2 Diver, E3 Tank, E4 Phaser, E5 Swarm, Boss) and the power-up gym scene: W/Up = forward thrust, A/Left + S/Right = turn (matching `GymPlayer`).
- **AC2 — 4-directional backward compatible:** With the 4-directional scheme saved, movement in those scenes is unchanged (WASD/arrows) — no regression.
- **AC3 — Scheme-aware input wiring:** `GymFormationScene._readPlayerInput()` and `GymPowerUps._readInput()` (and any remaining legacy `keysToInput` user) route input through the pluggable `InputHandler` classes keyed off `player.getScheme()` — the same pattern `GymPlayer` already uses (`AsteroidsInputHandler` / `FourDirectionalInputHandler`) — rather than the hard-wired 4-directional mapping.
- **AC4 — Validation/tests:** Automated tests cover both schemes' input mapping for the affected scenes (per-scene assertions + a regression test for the asteroids scheme), and the full project test suite passes with the new changes.
- **AC5 — Documentation:** All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs-site entries (incl. the player-in-enemy-gym convention doc AH-0MTECNKXX001XBLJ).

## Constraints

- **Interim fix in the current scene structure** — explicitly NOT blocked on the Enemy Design tooling item (AH-0MTFP7EIC004F1MN); that refactor will supersede this per-scene wiring (dependency note recorded).
- Backward compatible: the 4-directional scheme must keep working untouched.
- Scope is bug-fix only: no new control schemes, no enemy config work, no refactor of the scenes themselves.
- Note: **GymWeapons** (weapons gym scene) uses the identical legacy `keysToInput` pattern and is affected the same way — in scope (same one-line fix pattern).

## Existing State

- `Player` constructor and `setConfig` load the saved ship config (`loadShipConfig()`), which persists `controlScheme` + `asteroidsRotationSpeed` (src/core/config.ts); the ship installs the matching pluggable model (`AsteroidsModel` / `FourDirectionalModel`) and expects the matching input shape (src/entities/Player.ts:194-215, 342-343, 411-432).
- `GymPlayer` (ship-config gym) already uses the pluggable handlers: `AsteroidsInputHandler.mapInput(raw)` / `FourDirectionalInputHandler.mapInput(raw)` keyed off `player.getScheme()` (src/scenes/gym/GymPlayer.ts:88, 338-353) — this scene works.
- Enemy gyms extend `GymFormationScene`, whose `_readPlayerInput()` calls `keysToInput(cursors, wasd)` (src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.ts:495-499) — always 4-directional.
- `GymPowerUps` (extends `Phaser.Scene`) calls `keysToInput(cursors, wasd)` at src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUps.ts:241.
- `GymWeapons` (extends `Phaser.Scene`) calls `keysToInput(cursors, wasd)` at src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:353.
- Pluggable classes already exist in src/utils/movementModel.ts: `FourDirectionalInputHandler` / `AsteroidsInputHandler` (map raw `{ cursors, wasd }` key state to the scheme-appropriate `ControlInput` shape).

## Desired Change

- Replace the legacy `keysToInput` wiring in `GymFormationScene` (base, fixing all six enemy gyms at once) and in `GymPowerUps` (and `GymWeapons`) with scheme-aware `InputHandler` routing mirroring `GymPlayer._readInput()`.
- Add/extend unit tests asserting scheme-correct input mapping per scene, plus a regression test that an asteroids-scheme player in these scenes receives `{ forward, turnLeft, turnRight }`.
- Record a dependency/related note on AH-0MTFP7EIC004F1MN (Enemy Design tooling) so the config-driven restructure supersedes this per-scene wiring.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.ts` — `_readPlayerInput()` fixed to use scheme-aware `InputHandler` (fixes E1–E5 + Boss)
- `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUps.ts` — `_readInput()` fixed the same way
- `src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts` — `_readInput()` fixed the same way (discovered affected site)
- `src/scenes/gym/GymPlayer.ts` — reference implementation for the scheme-aware pattern (no change expected)
- `src/utils/movementModel.ts` — `AsteroidsInputHandler` / `FourDirectionalInputHandler` (already exist, consumed)
- `src/utils/input.ts` — legacy `keysToInput` helper (may be retired if no remaining users)
- Tests: `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.test.ts`, `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUps.test.ts`, `src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.test.ts`, plus per-scene gym tests

## Related Work

- **AH-0MTF0EFNZ000RPVD** — Alternative player control (completed; introduced the switchable schemes + persistence that caused this regression)
- **AH-0MTD0Z0Y7003T1NT** — Add player to each Enemy Gym scene (in-progress; wired player presence into these scenes)
- **AH-0MTFP7EIC004F1MN** — Enemy Design tooling (open, stage idea; the config-driven restructure this interim fix must not block on; dependency/related note recorded per operator decision)
- **AH-0MTECNKXX001XBLJ** — Docs: player-in-enemy-gym convention (completed; may need updating for scheme-aware input)
- **AH-0MTFORPJ2003RWWQ** — Asteroids directional VFX improvements (open; unrelated to this fix)

## Risks & Assumptions

- **Risk: other `keysToInput` call sites missed.** Mitigation: grep confirmed exactly three remaining non-test users (GymFormationScene, GymPowerUps, GymWeapons) — all in scope; `keysToInput` can be retired after the fix.
- **Risk: test stubs assume 4-directional input shape.** Existing scene tests may feed `MovementInput` directly; the fix must keep `setInput` accepting both shapes (it does) and update tests to assert scheme-correct shape.
- **Risk: scope creep toward the Enemy Design tooling refactor.** Explicitly out of scope — interim fix only; recorded as dependency note.
- **Assumption (operator, Q1):** enemy/power-up/weapons gyms honour the saved control scheme, exactly like `GymPlayer`.
- **Assumption (operator, Q3):** interim fix now, not blocked on AH-0MTFP7EIC004F1MN.
- **Assumption:** the player in these gyms is created with the saved config (so scheme is inherited); if a scene overrides config, the fix keys off `player.getScheme()` at read time regardless.

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions

- **Q1 (expected behaviour):** Should the enemy gym and power-up gym scenes honour the saved control scheme (asteroids controls work there too), or always force 4-directional? — **Answer (rgardler):** "Honour the saved preference". Source: interactive reply during intake AH-0MTFPDKDU006QUDC.
- **Q2 (scope):** Does "enemy gym scenes" cover E1 Scout–E5 Swarm, Boss, and GymPowerUps, with GymPlayer unaffected? — **Answer (rgardler):** "all, however, note that there is an open work item to change the structure of these scenes to load a config for the enemy. This work would be less work if it were dependent upon that work item" (Enemy Design tooling AH-0MTFP7EIC004F1MN). Research: `grep keysToInput` shows GymWeapons is an additional affected site in scope.
- **Q3 (timing/dependency):** Fix now (interim) vs. block on Enemy Design tooling AH-0MTFP7EIC004F1MN (stage idea, medium priority)? — **Answer (rgardler):** "1" — interim fix now, with dependency/related note on the tooling item so the refactor supersedes this wiring. Source: interactive reply.
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **AH-0MTC0QPS60005MNT** – Create gym scene for power-ups with spawning, collection, and standalone HUD (completed)
- **AH-0MT9FS3DL0084Z6V** – Gym scene: ship config sliders, save button, half-speed ship (completed)
- **AH-0MT7O8KCY0059RA5** – Game Design Document for AI_Hell (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `README.md` — matched: also, asteroids, cannot, cause, context, control, critical, enemy, gym, moving, operator, player, power, priority, report, scene, scenes, since, style, sure, types
- `docs/Game Design Document.md` — matched: also, asteroids, cannot, cause, context, control, enemy, gym, moving, operator, player, power, scene, scenes, since, style, types
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` — matched: also, cannot, control, critical, enemy, gym, player, scene, scenes, style, types

# Scheme-aware input routing in gym scenes

## Summary
Replace the legacy keysToInput wiring with pluggable InputHandler routing keyed off player.getScheme() in GymFormationScene._readPlayerInput(), GymPowerUps._readInput(), and GymWeapons._readInput(), mirroring GymPlayer.

## Acceptance Criteria
- GymFormationScene._readPlayerInput() routes raw { cursors, wasd } through AsteroidsInputHandler / FourDirectionalInputHandler keyed off player.getScheme() (fixes E1-E5 + Boss).
- GymPowerUps._readInput() and GymWeapons._readInput() use the same scheme-aware routing.
- With the asteroids scheme saved, the player moves in all affected scenes (W/Up = forward thrust, A/Left + S/Right = turn), matching GymPlayer behaviour.
- The 4-directional scheme is fully backward compatible - movement in all scenes unchanged (no regression).
- keysToInput (src/utils/input.ts) and its test (src/utils/input.test.ts) are retired once no non-test users remain (operator decision Q1: option a - retire).
- All F1 tests pass and the full project test suite passes.

## Minimal Implementation
- In each _readInput/_readPlayerInput, build the raw { cursors, wasd } key state and route by player.getScheme() using the existing handlers from src/utils/movementModel.ts.
- Keep setInput accepting both input shapes (it already does).
- Remove keysToInput imports/usages; retire the helper and its test as the final cleanup.
- Grep to confirm zero remaining keysToInput users (non-test and test).

## Dependencies
- Parent: Player cannot be moved in enemy and power-up gym scenes (AH-0MTFPDKDU006QUDC)
- Depends on: Scheme-aware input tests for affected gym scenes (F1 test-first)
- Superseded later by: Enemy Design tooling (AH-0MTFP7EIC004F1MN) - interim fix only, per operator decision Q3.

## Deliverables
- Changed files: src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.ts, src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUps.ts, src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts
- Retired: src/utils/input.ts helper + src/utils/input.test.ts

**Key Files:**
- `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.ts`
- `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUps.ts`
- `src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts`
- `src/utils/input.ts`
- `src/utils/input.test.ts`

# Scheme-aware input tests for affected gym scenes

## Summary
Extend per-scene unit tests asserting scheme-correct input mapping for GymFormationScene (base, covers E1-E5 + Boss), GymPowerUps, and GymWeapons, plus a regression test for asteroids-scheme players, keyed off player.getScheme().

## Acceptance Criteria
- GymFormationScene.test.ts gains cases: an asteroids-scheme player receives { forward, turnLeft, turnRight } from W/Up / A/Left / S/Right; a 4-directional player receives { up, down, left, right }.
- GymPowerUps.test.ts and GymWeapons.test.ts gain equivalent per-scene assertions keyed off player.getScheme().
- A regression test asserts an asteroids-scheme player in these scenes receives asteroids-shaped input (never 4-directional).
- Tests are written before F2 implementation (red), and pass after it lands (green).
- The full project test suite passes with the new tests.

## Minimal Implementation
- Mirror the scheme-handling used in existing bootScene-based gym tests; drive held keys via the scene cursors/wasd test accessors.
- Key assertions off player.getScheme() the way GymPlayer tests do.
- Add a per-scene helper to set the player scheme before assertions (asteroids vs four-directional).

## Deliverables
- Updated test files: src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.test.ts, src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUps.test.ts, src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.test.ts

**Key Files:**
- `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.test.ts`
- `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUps.test.ts`
- `src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.test.ts`
